name: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
summary: Tabetha asks you to cleanse the Orb of Orahil by confronting the demon bound within. Menara waits for the cleansed orb.

sections.title: Tabetha's Request
sections.body: The summoner's orb bears a taint, and Tabetha offers to draw out the demon within. You are to face it after she releases it. Menara is waiting for the orb once it has been cleansed.

faq.q: What is wrong with the Orb of Orahil?
faq.answer: A demon within the Orb of Orahil is causing its taint.
Tabetha says she can exorcise the demon from the Orb of Orahil.

faq.q: What does Tabetha ask me to do?
faq.answer: You are to kill the demon Tabetha releases, then speak with her.

faq.q: Why does Tabetha say to be quick?
faq.answer: If the demon is not killed quickly, it will return to the orb and the attempt must begin again.

faq.q: Who is waiting for the cleansed orb?
faq.answer: Menara is waiting for the cleansed Orb of Orahil.
